title: Traffic police officer crashes motorcycle into back of car along PIE while apparently looking at driver on his left
text:
Traffic police officer crashes motorcycle into back of car along PIE while apparently looking at driver on his left - Mothership.SG - News from Singapore, Asia and around the world 
 ">
News
 Traffic police officer crashes motorcycle into back of car along PIE while apparently looking at driver on his left
 Three people were taken to the hospital.
 Belmont Lay 
 November 04, 2026, 10:09 PM
Photo from SGRV Facebook
 A traffic police officer on a motorcycle was caught on camera rear-ending a car on the Pan Island Expressway (PIE) towards Tuas. 
 A video showed the officer on the right-most lane apparently with his head turned towards the car to his left. 
 The officer then rode into the back of a white car as traffic on the lane had come to a standstill. 
 The ensuing crash caused debris to be scattered on the road. 
 In response to Moterhship 's queries, the police said they were alerted to the incident on Nov. 4 at about 7:10am. 
 The accident involved two cars and two motorcycles, one of which is a traffic police (TP) motorcycle, the police added. 
 A 26-year-old male traffic police outrider, a 28-year-old female motorcyclist and a 20-year-old male car passenger were conveyed conscious to the hospital. 
 Police investigations are ongoing.
